about_the_game:
As the new trainee gatekeeper of the Shanhai Division, you stand at the intersection of Kyushu - this is the city under the rule of the Yin Dynasty

During the day, the crowd is surging, and there is an endless stream of merchant monks;

As night fell, the aura filled the air, and hundreds of ghosts donned human skins and waited for an opportunity to move.

Your mission: to take charge of the city gate and see through the virtual and the real

Inspect every passerby to make sure no suspicious cultivators or monsters enter the city!

Cunning enemies are good at camouflage, and flaws are fleeting—either hidden in subtle anomalies or hidden in logical cracks between words. You need to see through the details and make good use of all kinds of props to see through the layers of disguise and protect the peace of the city.

Different types of "suspicious people"

encountering all kinds of strange evil cultivators and monsters: or disguising themselves seamlessly, only words can find clues; Or there are many tricks, but they show their feet in appearance.

Rich events and choices

Your judgment will stir the storm. one negligence may lead to the city of catastrophe; A clear decision may also quietly change the trajectory of the fate of others. Different choices lead to very different game progressions and multiple endings.

Talent and city

Choose a unique starting identity and talent to start your own gatekeeper experience.

Garrisoned in the cities of the Yin Dynasty with different styles, facing different terroirs and challenges.

Outside of Duties:

Reward for arresting criminals: Accurately identify key criminals on the list and arrest them.

Secret Cases: Deal with special gatekeeper incidents under the secrets of the Mountain and Sea Division to deal with unimaginable crises.

More content?

It only exists in the various content that may appear in the future, whether it is the developer's plan or the whims of the players, it can only be said that everything is in a dark and bright future......

short_description: 《Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty》 is an independent game with a fantasy fairy tale theme, and the core gameplay focuses on "identifying fakes and identifying monsters". Every decision you make is not only about the safety of the people in the city, but also about the profound impact on the entire city
